from runtime import WorldSpec, Scene, Condition as C, Effect as E, Rule
from runtime import observe, tell, transfer
import random


def build(seed: int) -> WorldSpec:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    entities = {
        "ada": {"name": "Ada", "kind": "child"},
        "brindle": {"name": "Brindle", "kind": "dragon"},
        "keeper": {"name": "Keeper Moss", "kind": "person"},
        "nella": {"name": "Nella", "kind": "person"},
        "tower": {"name": "clocktower", "kind": "place"},
        "upper": {"name": "upper clubroom", "kind": "place"},
        "lower": {"name": "lower landing", "kind": "place"},
        "house": {"name": "nearby house", "kind": "place"},
        "bell": {"name": "bell", "kind": "prop"},
        "rope": {"name": "bell-rope", "kind": "prop"},
        "gear": {"name": "brass gear", "kind": "prop"},
        "notice": {"name": "noticeboard", "kind": "prop"},
        "cushions": {"name": "cushions", "kind": "prop"},
        "lantern": {"name": "lantern", "kind": "prop"},
        "flag": {"name": "club flag", "kind": "prop"},
        "room": {"name": "clubroom", "kind": "state"},
        "papers": {"name": "tower papers", "kind": "state"},
        "signal": {"name": "club signal", "kind": "state"},
        "meeting": {"name": "club meeting", "kind": "state"},
        "club": {"name": "clocktower club", "kind": "group"},
    }

    bell_stuck = rng.choice([True, False])
    cluttered = rng.choice([True, False])
    asleep = rng.choice([True, False])
    frosty = rng.choice([True, False])
    care = rng.choice([1, 2])

    initial = {
        "ada.location": "tower",
        "brindle.location": "tower",
        "keeper.location": "tower",
        "nella.location": "house",

        "upper.accessible": True,
        "lower.accessible": True,

        "bell.location": "upper",
        "bell.stuck": bell_stuck,
        "bell.owner": "keeper",

        "rope.location": "upper",
        "rope.owner": "keeper",

        "gear.location": "upper",
        "gear.aligned": not bell_stuck,
        "gear.frosty": frosty,

        "notice.location": "upper",
        "notice.outdated": True,
        "notice.clear": False,

        "cushions.location": "tower",
        "lantern.location": "tower",
        "lantern.owner": "keeper",
        "flag.location": "tower",

        "room.cluttered": cluttered,
        "papers.safe": True,

        "signal.mode": "confusing",
        "signal.tested": False,
        "meeting.place": "upper",
        "meeting.time": "unknown",
        "club.ready": False,

        "nella.asleep": asleep,
        "nella.quiet_needed": True,
        "nella.agreed": False,
        "nella.relocation_requested": False,

        "ada.memes.Curiosity": 0,
        "ada.memes.Cooperation": 0,
        "ada.memes.Ambition": 1,

        "brindle.memes.Curiosity": 0,
        "brindle.memes.Cooperation": 0,
        "brindle.memes.Ambition": 1,

        "keeper.memes.Care": care,

        "ada.knows.bell.stuck": None,
        "ada.knows.notice.outdated": None,
        "ada.knows.nella.quiet": None,
        "brindle.knows.gear.frosty": None,
        "brindle.knows.papers.safe": None,

        "keeper.knows.bell.stuck": None,
        "keeper.knows.notice.outdated": None,
        "keeper.knows.nella.quiet": None,

        "ada.has.rope": False,
        "ada.has.lantern": False,
        "upper.approved": False,
        "lower.arranged": False,
    }

    scenes = [
        Scene(
            "explore_tower",
            "observation",
            ("ada", "brindle"),
            (C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),),
            (
                E("ada.memes.Curiosity", 1, "inc"),
                E("brindle.memes.Curiosity", 1, "inc"),
                E("ada.memes.Cooperation", 1, "inc"),
            ),
            "Ada and Brindle explored the clocktower together",
        ),

        observe(
            "inspect_bell",
            "ada",
            "bell.stuck",
            requires=(
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1),
            ),
            summary="Ada inspected the bell",
        ),

        observe(
            "inspect_notice",
            "ada",
            "notice.outdated",
            requires=(
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1),
            ),
            summary="Ada inspected the old notice",
        ),

        observe(
            "inspect_gear",
            "brindle",
            "gear.frosty",
            requires=(
                C("brindle.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("brindle.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1),
            ),
            summary="Brindle inspected the brass gear",
        ),

        tell(
            "explain_bell",
            "ada",
            "keeper",
            "bell.stuck",
            requires=(
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("keeper.location", "eq", "tower"),
            ),
            summary="Ada explained the bell condition to Keeper Moss",
        ),

        tell(
            "explain_notice",
            "ada",
            "keeper",
            "notice.outdated",
            requires=(
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("keeper.location", "eq", "tower"),
            ),
            summary="Ada explained that the notice was outdated",
        ),

        tell(
            "keeper_quiet_advice",
            "keeper",
            "ada",
            "nella.quiet",
            requires=(
                C("keeper.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("keeper.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
            ),
            summary="Keeper Moss explained the neighbor's quiet concern",
        ),

        transfer(
            "lend_rope",
            "keeper",
            "ada",
            "rope",
            requires=(
                C("keeper.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("keeper.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
            ),
            summary="Keeper Moss lent Ada the bell-rope",
        ),

        transfer(
            "lend_lantern",
            "keeper",
            "ada",
            "lantern",
            requires=(
                C("keeper.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("keeper.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
            ),
            summary="Keeper Moss lent Ada the lantern",
        ),

        Scene(
            "loosen_frost",
            "experimentation",
            ("brindle", "ada"),
            (
                C("brindle.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("brindle.knows.gear.frosty", "eq", True),
                C("gear.frosty", "eq", True),
                C("papers.safe", "eq", True),
            ),
            (
                E("gear.frosty", False),
                E("brindle.memes.Cooperation", 1, "inc"),
            ),
            "Brindle used a careful warm breath to loosen the frosty gear",
        ),

        Scene(
            "realign_gear",
            "cooperation",
            ("ada", "keeper"),
            (
                C("ada.has.rope", "eq", True),
                C("rope.owner", "eq", "ada"),
                C("keeper.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("ada.knows.bell.stuck", "eq", True),
                C("gear.frosty", "eq", False),
                C("bell.stuck", "eq", True),
            ),
            (
                E("gear.aligned", True),
                E("bell.stuck", False),
                E("signal.mode", "bell"),
                E("ada.has.rope", False),
                E("rope.owner", "keeper"),
            ),
            "Ada and Keeper Moss carefully realigned the bell gear",
        ),

        Scene(
            "post_clear_notice",
            "communication",
            ("ada", "brindle"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("brindle.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("notice.location", "eq", "upper"),
                C("ada.knows.notice.outdated", "eq", True),
            ),
            (
                E("notice.outdated", False),
                E("notice.clear", True),
                E("signal.mode", "visual"),
            ),
            "Ada replaced the confusing notice with a clear visual schedule",
        ),

        Scene(
            "ask_nella",
            "care",
            ("ada", "nella"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("nella.location", "eq", "house"),
                C("ada.knows.nella.quiet", "eq", True),
            ),
            (
                E("nella.agreed", True),
                E("meeting.time", "daytime"),
                E("nella.asleep", False),
            ),
            "Ada asked Nella about a quiet daytime club",
        ),

        Scene(
            "choose_relocation",
            "care",
            ("ada", "nella"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("nella.location", "eq", "house"),
                C("ada.knows.nella.quiet", "eq", True),
                C("nella.quiet_needed", "eq", True),
                C("nella.agreed", "eq", False),
            ),
            (
                E("nella.relocation_requested", True),
                E("meeting.place", "lower"),
                E("meeting.time", "daytime"),
                E("signal.mode", "visual"),
            ),
            "Nella requested a quiet club on the lower landing",
        ),

        Scene(
            "arrange_lower",
            "physical_arrangement",
            ("ada", "brindle"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("brindle.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("meeting.place", "eq", "lower"),
            ),
            (
                E("cushions.location", "lower"),
                E("lantern.location", "lower"),
                E("flag.location", "lower"),
                E("lower.arranged", True),
                E("room.cluttered", False),
            ),
            "Ada and Brindle arranged cushions and a lantern on the lower landing",
        ),

        Scene(
            "arrange_upper",
            "physical_arrangement",
            ("ada", "brindle"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("brindle.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("meeting.place", "eq", "upper"),
                C("room.cluttered", "eq", False),
            ),
            (
                E("cushions.location", "upper"),
                E("lantern.location", "upper"),
            ),
            "Ada and Brindle arranged the upper clubroom",
        ),

        Scene(
            "test_bell_signal",
            "experimentation",
            ("ada", "keeper"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("keeper.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("signal.mode", "eq", "bell"),
                C("bell.stuck", "eq", False),
                C("nella.asleep", "eq", False),
                C("nella.agreed", "eq", True),
            ),
            (E("signal.tested", True),),
            "Ada and Keeper Moss tested one gentle bell signal",
        ),

        Scene(
            "test_visual_signal",
            "experimentation",
            ("ada", "brindle"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("brindle.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("signal.mode", "eq", "visual"),
                C("flag.location", "in", ("tower", "lower")),
            ),
            (
                E("signal.tested", True),
                E("flag.location", "lower"),
            ),
            "Ada and Brindle tested a quiet visual club signal",
        ),

        Scene(
            "approve_lower",
            "cooperation",
            ("keeper", "ada"),
            (
                C("keeper.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("signal.tested", "eq", True),
                C("meeting.place", "eq", "lower"),
                C("lower.arranged", "eq", True),
            ),
            (E("upper.approved", True),),
            "Keeper Moss approved the quiet lower arrangement",
        ),

        Scene(
            "hold_bell_club",
            "ambition",
            ("ada", "brindle", "keeper"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("brindle.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("keeper.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("meeting.place", "eq", "upper"),
                C("cushions.location", "eq", "upper"),
                C("bell.stuck", "eq", False),
                C("signal.mode", "eq", "bell"),
                C("signal.tested", "eq", True),
                C("nella.agreed", "eq", True),
                C("meeting.time", "eq", "daytime"),
            ),
            (E("club.ready", True),),
            "Ada and Brindle held the first daytime club beneath one gentle bell chime",
        ),

        Scene(
            "hold_lower_club",
            "ambition",
            ("ada", "brindle"),
            (
                C("ada.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("brindle.location", "eq", "tower"),
                C("meeting.place", "eq", "lower"),
                C("lower.arranged", "eq", True),
                C("signal.mode", "eq", "visual"),
                C("signal.tested", "eq", True),
                C("meeting.time", "eq", "daytime"),
                C("nella.relocation_requested", "eq", True),
            ),
            (E("club.ready", True),),
            "Ada and Brindle held the first no-bell club on the lower landing",
        ),
    ]

    rules = (
        Rule(
            "owned rope only",
            (C("ada.has.rope", "eq", True),),
            (C("rope.owner", "eq", "ada"),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "owned lantern only",
            (C("ada.has.lantern", "eq", True),),
            (C("lantern.owner", "eq", "ada"),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "unsafe bell signal forbidden",
            (
                C("nella.asleep", "eq", True),
                C("signal.mode", "eq", "bell"),
            ),
            (C("signal.tested", "eq", False),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "ready requires safe signal",
            (
                C("club.ready", "eq", True),
            ),
            (
                C("signal.mode", "in", ("visual", "bell")),
                C("signal.tested", "eq", True),
            ),
        ),
        Rule(
            "upper club requires agreement",
            (
                C("club.ready", "eq", True),
                C("meeting.place", "eq", "upper"),
            ),
            (C("nella.agreed", "eq", True),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "lower club requires arrangement",
            (
                C("club.ready", "eq", True),
                C("meeting.place", "eq", "lower"),
            ),
            (C("lower.arranged", "eq", True),),
        ),
    )

    goal = (
        C("club.ready", "eq", True),
        C("signal.tested", "eq", True),
    )

    labels = {
        "bell.stuck": "bell condition",
        "gear.aligned": "gear alignment",
        "gear.frosty": "gear frost",
        "room.cluttered": "room condition",
        "papers.safe": "paper safety",
        "signal.mode": "signal arrangement",
        "signal.tested": "signal tested",
        "meeting.place": "meeting place",
        "meeting.time": "meeting time",
        "nella.agreed": "Nella's agreement",
        "nella.relocation_requested": "Nella's relocation request",
        "club.ready": "club readiness",
    }

    return WorldSpec(
        "The Clocktower Club",
        entities,
        initial,
        tuple(scenes),
        goal,
        rules=rules,
        labels=labels,
    )
